floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Ranges follow the printed minimum and maximum figures. For Alton 2 BR Type A, the Min column prints 977.47 sq ft and the Max column prints 977.36 sq ft. The two totals are shown in source order. Confirm the correct unit area with Nshama. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 6 project renders from Nshama’s own live gallery. Two images from the 18 August 2026 DLD album for project 3685, mirrored by Continental Club. The original project board in the same album names Alton. Inspection record https://continentalclub.ae/project/alton-town-square/.
review.location: Project location confirmed on brochure physical page 8 and compared with the published building point. The display isolates the complete master-plan panel. The six time estimates are from page 6 and describe the community.
review.floorPlans: All 7 original physical pages of the official apartment plan PDF. Area tables checked visually. For Alton 2 BR Type A, the Min column prints 977.47 sq ft and the Max column prints 977.36 sq ft. The two totals are shown in source order. Confirm the correct unit area with Nshama.
